::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru RF-IC firm founded 2020. In September 2025 it announced staggered volume production from Q4 2025 of its FD3R4411 4-channel X-band beamformer, with Tata Electronics handling assembly and test (per a company press release; independent confirmation of volume shipments not found).
:::

## What does this firm design?

X-band (8–12 GHz) beamformer and RF front-end ICs for phased-array radar, satellite communications and 5G antenna arrays.
